recipe.criteria: Standing barbell calf raise on a step. Forefeet stay supported while both heels rise and lower; knees remain straight and bar stays across the upper back. 3.5 seconds rise, 1 second pause, 3.5 seconds lower.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
